rule: Second paper chosen before any data by a fixed rule: from the PubMed query '(novel[Title]) AND (inhibitor[Title]) AND (IC50[Abstract]) AND (kinase[Title/Abstract] OR enzyme[Title/Abstract]) NOT review[pt]' restricted to 2026/10/15-2026/11/19, the most recent peer-reviewed small-molecule inhibitor paper with an IC50 in its abstract, after the first paper. Preprints (Res Sq) excluded.
